short_description: Interfaces should not contain irrelevant or rarely needed information. Every element should serve a purpose.

positive.definition: Visual hierarchy clearly directs attention to the primary action or information
positive.evidence_required: name the surface and the hierarchy elements

positive.definition: Color is used purposefully to communicate state or hierarchy, not decoration
positive.evidence_required: name the color use and what it communicates

positive.definition: Complex options are hidden behind progressive disclosure rather than dumped on the user
positive.evidence_required: name the surface and the disclosed control

positive.definition: Layout uses generous whitespace that lets primary content breathe
positive.evidence_required: name the surface and the whitespace

positive.definition: Visual style has personality or distinct point of view (does not look generic)

negative.definition: Surface is dense with controls or content competing for attention with no clear focus
negative.evidence_required: name the surface and the competing elements

negative.definition: Color is used for decoration with no relationship to information or state
All elements have equal visual weight so nothing reads as primary
Padding and spacing are cramped, making the surface feel airless
Layout looks like the default of an AI template (no distinct point of view)

critical_negative.definition: Density and visual noise are so high a first-time user cannot find the primary action
